headline.line: This study analyzed speeding behavior across more than 120,000 highway segments in a statewide network using 3.5TB of Wejo connected vehicle trajectory data.

synthesis.paragraph: Today's urban data science literature includes two papers from the Institute of Transport Economics. Among these, "Small talk in a small vehicle" shares 3 references with the June 29 paper "Shared autonomous vehicles and inclusive mobility". These shared references are "Understanding acceptance of shared autonomous vehicles among people with different mobility and communication needs", "Experiences of older adults interacting with a shared autonomous vehicle and recommendations for future implementation", and "Factors influencing the user behaviour of shared autonomous vehicles (SAVs): A systematic literature review". Over the last 30 days, Hong Kong Polytechnic University appeared on 20 papers, Tsinghua University and University of Hong Kong both appeared on 16 papers, and Tongji University appeared on 15 papers.
